@graph.description: A doctor-led scalp microneedling protocol using Mesoestetic c.prof 231 Dutexome Solution for selected patients with androgenetic alopecia or diffuse hair thinning.

acceptedAnswer.text: Dutexome (Mesoestetic c.prof 231) combines 0.05% dutasteride with plant-based exosomes, copper tripeptide, biotin and B-complex vitamins, delivered into the scalp through microneedling.

mainEntity.name: How is Dutexome different from QR678 or GFC?

acceptedAnswer.text: QR678 and GFC deliver growth factors intended to support follicles. Dutexome combines a regenerative approach with locally applied dutasteride, addressing DHT-driven pattern hair loss while supporting the follicular environment.

mainEntity.name: Is Dutexome the same as taking dutasteride tablets?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Dutexome applies dutasteride directly to the scalp at a low concentration rather than as a daily oral tablet. It is intended to reduce systemic exposure compared with oral treatment, but some absorption may still occur, so your full medical history must be reviewed.

It uses a CE-marked professional formulation from Mesoestetic. As with any dutasteride-containing product, it is not suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Dr. Sandeep reviews your medical history and contraindications before recommending treatment.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: The number of sessions depends on your hair loss stage and scalp condition. Dr. Sandeep will recommend a personalized session plan after your scalp evaluation.
Because this is a microneedling-based procedure, you may feel mild discomfort or tingling during the session, similar to other mesotherapy treatments offered at the clinic.

mainEntity.name: Can I combine Dutexome with other treatments?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is decided case by case based on your hair loss pattern and any other treatments, such as PRP, GFC or post-transplant care, that you may be undergoing.
Dutasteride-based treatments require careful individual evaluation for women, particularly in relation to pregnancy status. Dr. Sandeep will assess suitability during consultation.
